title: Bind same model candidate SHA through isolated checks and detached-worktree fixture creation
summary: A default-disabled, host-only P00-T20 coordinator independently checks the same model-authored Python fixture source/plan SHA through optional rootless syntax and fixed functional verdict receipts, then creates exactly those source bytes in a non-overwriting, pinned detached Git worktree only after exact passing test evidence. CI mocks model/Docker yet uses real private Git fixture file writes, not a deployed host or general app patcher.
migration_notes: No persistent worker, live Ollama/Docker attestation, user checkout or remote PR write. Operator-approved disposable Git fixture new file only; full P00-T20 and Issue #3 remain unfinished.
